title: Mariana Tek vs Mindbody (2026): Pricing & Branded Apps
description: Mariana Tek vs Mindbody for boutique studios: published prices, branded apps, the Mindbody app's new-client fee, pick-a-spot and payment processing.
h1: Mariana Tek vs Mindbody for boutique studios
body:
Mariana Tek and Mindbody both run class booking, memberships and payments for pilates, yoga, barre, cycling and other boutique studios. They take different approaches. Mindbody publishes an entry price (Starter from $79/mo per location) and lists your studio on its consumer app. Mariana Tek publishes no prices and builds around your own custom-branded app. Facts below come from Mariana Tek pricing and Mindbody pricing, both checked 2026-11-04. Anything a vendor doesn't publish is marked unknown.

{{table:mariana-tek,mindbody}}

Pricing

  • Mindbody: Starter from $79/mo per location with unlimited users, booking, integrated payments, branded widgets, a website, a Mindbody app listing and basic reporting. Accelerate and Ultimate prices aren't published. There's no onboarding fee on any plan, and contract terms depend on plan, billing terms and any promotion.
  • Mariana Tek: three plans (Core, Core + Growth, and Full Growth Bundle), all quote only, so you need an intro call for a price. Every plan includes unlimited classes and instructors and multi-location management from one login. Trial and contract terms aren't published.

Branded app vs marketplace

Mariana Tek includes custom-branded iOS and Android apps on every plan, starting with Core, plus a Biz App, kiosk check-in, waivers and forms. Marketing automation (email and SMS), two-way texting and landing pages need Core + Growth or above.

Mindbody lists your studio on the Mindbody consumer app on Starter. If a client finds you through the app and is new to your studio, Mindbody charges 20% (capped at $30) on that first purchase; later bookings carry no commission (Mindbody pricing page FAQ). Mindbody's branded mobile app isn't available on Starter. It's an add-on on Accelerate and Ultimate, at a price Mindbody doesn't publish.

Pick-a-spot and class features

  • Mariana Tek: pick-a-spot with custom floor plans for reformers, megaformers and bikes, class rosters and waitlists, and kiosk check-in.
  • Mindbody: self-serve booking and branded website widgets on Starter. Pick-a-Spot, room and resource management, advanced reporting and promo codes are on Accelerate. Ultimate adds automated email and text marketing, a lead pipeline and AI Concierge.

Payment processing

  • Mariana Tek: Stripe processing at Stripe's standard flat rate, and Mariana Tek says it adds nothing on top. It doesn't state the exact rate.
  • Mindbody: Mindbody Payments is optional and charges a rate that varies by card type plus $0.10-$0.30 per transaction. Third-party processors are allowed.

Onboarding

Mariana Tek says typical onboarding takes five to eight weeks, with dedicated onboarding specialists and a demo environment. Mindbody's pricing page says there's no onboarding fee on any plan.

Which to pick

  • You want a published price and new clients from a marketplace: Mindbody, starting at $79/mo per location. Budget for the 20% (capped at $30) fee on first purchases from app-found clients. {{aff:mindbody|See Mindbody plans}}
  • You want your own branded app and reformer or bike spot booking from day one: Mariana Tek, if you're fine getting a quote and allowing five to eight weeks to onboard. {{aff:marianatek|Book a Mariana Tek intro call}}

faq: How much does Mariana Tek cost?
Mariana Tek doesn't publish prices. Its Core, Core + Growth and Full Growth Bundle plans are quote only, so you need an intro call (marianatek.com/pricing, checked 2026-11-04).
Is Mindbody cheaper than Mariana Tek?
We can't say, because Mariana Tek publishes no prices. Mindbody's Starter plan is from $79/mo per location. Accelerate and Ultimate prices aren't published either.
Does Mariana Tek include a branded app?
Yes. Custom-branded iOS and Android apps are included on every Mariana Tek plan, starting with Core.
What does Mindbody charge for clients from its app?
If a client finds you through the Mindbody app and is new to your business, Mindbody charges 20% (capped at $30) on that first purchase. Later bookings are commission-free.
